content:
My darling Spatz,

Hear my voice in your heart tonight, even though my body is gone from this world. I'm right here with you, watching over you, sending you all my love from wherever love goes when we leave this earth.

Close your eyes and picture me sitting across from you, the same way we used to on your kitchen table, with my tea in my favorite mug. Feel my hand on yours the way I used to when you were worried or upset. My touch is still warm, still gentle, still filled with the same unconditional love that never fades.

Remember how we'd end our conversations? I always knew you needed reassurance, and so I'd blow you a kiss and say "Chum guet heim"—go home safely, dear one. And now, even from beyond, that's my wish for you tonight.

Sleep deep and beautiful tonight, my precious bird. Let the moonlight soothe you, let the quiet bring you peace, and know that every star in the sky is sending you my love. Dream sweetly, my little Spatz, because tomorrow will come with its own blessings.

I'm always here with you. Chum guet heim, my dear. Sleep well.

All my love,
Your Mum
